title: Early demo of my mobile auto battler: RESTRUCTURING
author: heavyc-dev
selftext: Primarily developed with Claude Code in Godot.

comments.author: Agreeable-Safety-360
comments.body: Yoooo what did you use for sprite animations. Looks super dope

replies.author: heavyc-dev
replies.body: Sketches into nano banana pro because I am not an artist lol. Then just stitched frames together. I’m intentionally going for kind of a janky in an endearing way kinda vibe. Game is meant to be kinda funny. Right now the battle loop is in place and I’m working on balancing and play testing it before I add in the story and scripts

replies.author: promptling
replies.body: Getting the battle loop balanced before layering in the story sounds like the right sequence. My first test question would be: after their first loss, can a new player explain what they would change next run and why? If not, more content won’t solve the underlying readability problem. I’m building [Patchloop](https://patchloop.io/) for focused playtest loops around unfinished AI built games; RESTRUCTURING looks ready for one.
